name: ctml-skills
description: Agent skills for statistical methods research: simulation studies, supervised learning, readable math, and reproducible papers.

plugins.name: stats-research
plugins.description: Design and report simulation studies, set up and tune supervised learners (including Riesz regression), and check that mathematical writing is readable.

plugins.name: paper-pipeline
plugins.description: Keep a code repo and its Overleaf manuscript in step, so every figure, table and inline number is built by the pipeline and stamped with the commit that made it.

plugins.name: claude-code-utils
plugins.description: Utilities for Claude Code itself, such as keeping a project's session history when its folder is moved or renamed.
